candidates.summary: gnodev hot reload is refused when the page is opened at http://localhost:8888, the URL the docs give, because the same-origin check compares localhost:8888 with the 127.0.0.1:8888 host the injected script dials
candidates.failure_scenario: gnodev local on its default -web-listener 127.0.0.1:8888 (command_local.go:34); user opens http://localhost:8888 as docs/resources/gnodev.md:39 and contribs/gnodev/README.md:16 say; hotreload.js dials ws://127.0.0.1:8888/_events (app.go:492 builds it from webListenerAddr) with Origin http://localhost:8888; CheckOrigin nil falls to gorilla checkSameOrigin, which compares Origin host localhost:8888 to Host 127.0.0.1:8888 and returns 403. The page never reloads on file save, tx or reset; the only trace is a console 'WebSocket Error' and an 'unable to upgrade connection' line in gnodev's Event log. At the merge base CheckOrigin returned true and the same page reloads.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/solo-finder-1-gnodev-localhost-hotreload_test.go contribs/gnodev/pkg/emitter/ && (cd contribs/gnodev && go test -count=1 -run TestSoloFinder1 -v ./pkg/emitter): head localhost_page 403, base 101; real app: bash tests/solo-finder-1-gnodev-localhost-hotreload.sh <gnodev built from the tree> <tree> <tag> loads http://localhost:18888 in chromium
candidates.evidence: head go test: 'page origin http://localhost:41731 -> ws://127.0.0.1:41731/_events status 403 err websocket: bad handshake', 127_page 101; base (overlay, d25b308c1): both 101, PASS. Real gnodev + headless chromium at head, page http://localhost:18888/: console 'WebSocket Error: [object Event]', gnodev log 'unable to upgrade connection ... error="websocket: request origin not allowed by Upgrader.CheckOrigin"'; page http://127.0.0.1:18888/: 0 errors. Same run on a gnodev built at the merge base: 0 upgrade errors for both pages.

candidates.summary: with cors_allowed_origins narrowed to any list without "*", OriginAllowed reads an absent Origin as "" and refuses the upgrade, so every non-browser websocket client is cut off, unlike the HTTP CORS path the PR body says it matches (carried from round 2, re-verified at dd05df75b)
candidates.failure_scenario: Operator sets cors_allowed_origins = ["https://gno.land", "https://*.gno.land"] to keep foreign dApps off; node.go:951-952 passes the list to NewWebsocketManager; a subscriber using the in-tree ws client (tm2/pkg/bft/rpc/lib/client/ws/client.go:42 dials with nil headers) or any gorilla/Go/CLI client sends no Origin and gets 403, so indexers and event subscribers stop connecting after a config change that HTTP clients survive (rs/cors handleActualRequest passes a missing Origin through, cors.go:415-416). The test case 'no origin header is allowed' only runs the empty list, which takes gorilla's same-origin path, so no test covers a narrowed list without Origin.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/solo-finder-1-narrowed-no-origin_test.go tm2/pkg/bft/rpc/lib/server/ && go test -count=1 -run TestSoloFinder1 -v ./tm2/pkg/bft/rpc/lib/server: expect no_origin_cli 101, observe 403
candidates.evidence: head: 'origin "" -> status 403 err websocket: bad handshake' (expected 101, actual 403); allowed_page https://app.gno.land 101; cross_site_page 403; null_origin_page 403. Base NewWebsocketManager took no origins and its CheckOrigin returned true (diff lines removed at handlers.go). rs/cors v1.11.1 cors.go:415-416 HTTP path: 'Actual request no headers added: missing origin' then serves.
